text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: quasar-prod-vpc - elevated error rates on dedicated pool Q-prim. 503 spikes, tenant qsr-42 latency > 10s. Pager runbook: runbook/incidents/vpc-high-err
oncall-eng: Ack. Jumping in. Is this already isolated to Q-prim?
sam-ops: I see increased tail latency on rtx0 devices, replicated across two hosts. Logs show KV cache eviction floods.
maria-csm: CSM here — quasar (enterprise) is impacted; notifying customer success ops. They have live traffic and execs standing by.
raj-sre: @oncall-eng please capture: run `kubectl logs -l pool=Q-prim --tail=200` and paste errors. Also temp route traffic to fallback pool Q-fallback: `trafficctl reroute --from Q-prim --to Q-fallback --filter tenant=qsr-42`
oncall-eng: Doing that now. Pasting relevant error snippet:
```
E2026-03-17T14:05:12Z redis: OOM when rebuilding prefix cache for tenant qsr-42
WARN kvcache: eviction backlog > 1000
```
elaine-eng: Looks like cache rebuild storms for a hot prefix. Suggest enabling prefix-deny for qsr-42 and throttle rebuilds: `cfg set evict.throttle=200ms` on Q-prim nodes.
oncall-eng: Reroute completed — trafficctl returned 200 OK. Latency for qsr-42 on Q-fallback down to 180ms. :thumbsup:
maria-csm: Sending short customer note: "We've rerouted your traffic to a safe pool while we investigate. No data loss expected. We'll follow up with RCA and mitigation plan." Send to their primary contact? @maria-csm yes.
exec-ops: Execs want a short incident brief for Quasar: impact window, affected tenants, mitigation, proposed credits. Draft an exec one-pager.
raj-sre: Root cause hypothesis: aggressive KV cache rebuild after a failed GC coupled with kernel OOM on two GPUs. We'll collect kernel logs and pmap dumps.
oncall-eng: Handing off to night SREs @kevin-support for live monitoring. I've attached commands we ran and current state.
kevin-support: Acknowledged. Will watch for requeue and check KMS calls for any access anomalies. Also will start a follow-up task to test quantized model warming which may have triggered rebuild.
elaine-eng: For RCA draft — include timeline, mitigation (reroute), short-term fix (eviction throttle + prefix-deny), medium-term (guardrails on model warming during rolling restarts), and credit calc: 2 hours of impacted traffic -> propose 20% service credit for the billing period.
maria-csm: I'll coordinate customer comms and get approval for the credit proposal. Planning a call with Quasar CISO at 17:30 PST.
oncall-eng: Closing pager. Monitoring continues. Will post RCA draft when available. :white_check_mark:
